Definition: to sow; figuratively, to disseminate, plant, fructify
BiblicalUsage: 1) to sow, scatter seed; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to sow; 1a2) producing, yielding seed; 1b)(Niphal); 1b1) to be sown; 1b2) to become pregnant, be made pregnant; 1c) (Pual) to be sown; 1d) (Hiphil) to produce seed, yield seed
